text: Hello and welcome to Real Easy English,
zh: 你好，欢迎收听《简易英语》
zh_hant: 你好，歡迎收聽《簡易英語》

text: where we have easy conversations to help you with your listening skills and learn new vocabulary.
zh: 在那里，我们通过轻松的对话来帮助你提升听力技巧并学习新词汇。
zh_hant: 在那裡，我們透過輕鬆的對話來幫助你提升聽力技巧並學習新詞彙。

text: I'm Bekka.
And I'm Neil.
If you'd like to see a video version of this podcast,
zh: 如果你想看这个播客的视频版，
zh_hant: 如果你想看這個播客的影片版，

text: you can find it on our website at bbclearningenglish.com.
zh: 可以在我们的网站bbclearningenglish.com上找到。
zh_hant: 可以在我們的網站bbclearningenglish.com上找到。

text: The video has subtitles, which can help you learn.
zh: 视频带有字幕，有助于你学习。
zh_hant: 影片帶有字幕，有助於你學習。

text: Hi Neil, how are you doing today?
I'm good, thank you.
I feel great because I just ate a banana.
zh: 我感觉特别好，因为我刚吃了一根香蕉。
zh_hant: 我感覺特別好，因為我剛吃了一根香蕉。

text: Yum.
I saw you started off your day quite healthily this morning.
zh: 我看到你今天早上一天开始得很健康。
zh_hant: 我看到你今天早上一天開始得很健康。

text: I also had a banana.
Yes, I saw you eating your banana and I thought, I'm going to eat a banana too.
zh: 是的，我看到你吃香蕉，心里想我也要吃一根。
zh_hant: 是的，我看到你吃香蕉，心裡想我也要吃一根。

text: Really?
Yes, bananas are delicious.
And today we are actually talking about fruit.
zh: 今天我们要聊的其实正是水果。
zh_hant: 今天我們要聊的其實正是水果。

text: We are, yes.
And I love eating fruit.
Me too.
What kind of fruit do you like?
Besides bananas, I really love berries.
zh: 除了香蕉，我非常喜欢浆果。
zh_hant: 除了香蕉，我非常喜歡漿果。

text: And I like green apples and red grapes.
zh: 我喜欢青苹果和红葡萄。
zh_hant: 我喜歡青蘋果和紅葡萄。

text: I like lots of fruit.
How about you?
Yeah, I really like fruit.
I try to eat fruit every day.
And like you, I like apples, but not just green ones.
zh: 和你一样，我也喜欢苹果，但不仅仅是青的。
zh_hant: 和你一樣，我也喜歡蘋果，但不僅僅是青的。

text: The red ones, I like those too.
And oranges.
And I like frozen berries with my breakfast.
zh: 早餐时我喜欢吃冷冻浆果。
zh_hant: 早餐時我喜歡吃冷凍漿果。

text: So you mentioned oranges.
Oranges can be a little sweet,
but they're actually more sour, aren't they?
zh: 但实际上它们更酸，对吧？
zh_hant: 但實際上它們更酸，對吧？

text: Yeah, sour or sharp.
Sharp, yeah.
Yeah, that's the taste that you get from fruit
zh: 对，那就是你从水果中尝到的味道，
zh_hant: 對，那就是你從水果中嚐到的味道，

text: like oranges and more so with lemons or limes.
zh: 像橙子，尤其是柠檬或酸橙更是如此。
zh_hant: 像橙子，尤其是檸檬或酸橙更是如此。

text: These are called citrus fruit.
zh: 这些被称为柑橘类水果。
zh_hant: 這些被稱為柑橘類水果。

text: Yeah, citrus fruit.
They have more of a sour taste.
Yeah, if you bite into a lemon, that's sour.
zh: 对，如果你咬一口柠檬，那很酸。
zh_hant: 對，如果你咬一口檸檬，那很酸。

text: Yeah, the face that you make when you bite into something citrus.
zh: 对，就是咬柑橘类东西时你做的那个表情。
zh_hant: 對，就是咬柑橘類東西時你做的那個表情。

text: Do you prefer sweet fruit or sour fruit?
zh: 你更喜欢甜水果还是酸水果？
zh_hant: 你更喜歡甜水果還是酸水果？

text: I like sweet fruit,
and probably I like fruit when it's ripe.
zh: 而且我可能更喜欢熟透了的水果。
zh_hant: 而且我可能更喜歡熟透了的水果。

text: OK.
What does that mean, ripe?
It means that it's ready to eat.
zh: 意思是它已经到了可以吃的时候。
zh_hant: 意思是它已經到了可以吃的時候。

text: It's at its sweetest usually,
probably quite juicy.
If fruit is juicy, it means juice comes from it,
zh: 如果水果多汁，意思是果汁从中流出，
zh_hant: 如果水果多汁，意思是果汁從中流出，

text: and juice is liquid, watery.
And it's, if it's ripe,
it's just before it goes bad or goes off.
zh: 它就在变质或坏掉之前。
zh_hant: 它就在變質或壞掉之前。

text: Right, I see.
So if we're thinking about bananas, for example,
a green coloured banana perhaps isn't ready to eat.
zh: 绿色的香蕉可能还不能吃。
zh_hant: 綠色的香蕉可能還不能吃。

text: It's not ripe like a yellow banana.
zh: 它不像黄色的香蕉那样熟。
zh_hant: 它不像黃色的香蕉那樣熟。

text: Yeah, but a yellow one with sort of brown bits on it,
zh: 对，但黄色带棕色斑点的，
zh_hant: 對，但黃色帶棕色斑點的，

text: that's a ripe banana.
Yeah, they're a bit too sweet for me.
zh: 对，那种对我来说太甜了。
zh_hant: 對，那種對我來說太甜了。

text: I kind of like that middle.
zh: 我比较喜欢中间那个程度。
zh_hant: 我比較喜歡中間那個程度。

text: Yeah, I like yellow bananas.
How about dried fruit?
Do you like dried fruit?
Oh, I'm glad you asked.
Yes, I really like dried fruit.
zh: 是的，我真的很喜欢干果。
zh_hant: 是的，我真的很喜歡乾果。

text: So I will often have raisins.
So raisins are dried grapes.
zh: 葡萄干就是干了的葡萄。
zh_hant: 葡萄乾就是幹了的葡萄。

text: And dried means that it doesn't have any of that juice or liquid.
zh: 干的意思是它没有那些汁水或液体了。
zh_hant: 乾的意思是它沒有那些汁水或液體了。

text: So Becca, here is a really important and interesting question.
zh: 那么贝卡，这里有一个非常重要且有趣的问题。
zh_hant: 那麼貝卡，這裡有一個非常重要且有趣的問題。

text: If you could only eat one fruit for the rest of your life,
zh: 如果余生你只能吃一种水果，
zh_hant: 如果餘生你只能吃一種水果，

text: which would you choose?
Oh, that is a very difficult question.
We've talked a lot about the fruit that we love,
zh: 我们聊了很多我们喜欢的水果，
zh_hant: 我們聊了很多我們喜歡的水果，

text: but probably bananas because I do eat them every day.
zh: 但可能香蕉吧，因为我确实每天都吃。
zh_hant: 但可能香蕉吧，因為我確實每天都吃。

text: It feels quite strange to not eat a banana every day for me.
zh: 对我来说，每天不吃香蕉感觉很奇怪。
zh_hant: 對我來說，每天不吃香蕉感覺很奇怪。

text: And also I really enjoy banana bread and dried bananas.
zh: 而且我也很喜欢香蕉面包和香蕉干。
zh_hant: 而且我也很喜歡香蕉麵包和香蕉幹。

text: I completely forgot about those.
They're really tasty.
So yeah, there's lots of things you can do with bananas.
zh: 所以香蕉可以做很多不同的东西。
zh_hant: 所以香蕉可以做很多不同的東西。

text: Probably those.
How about you?
What fruit would you choose?
I think maybe it sounds boring,
zh: 我觉得可能听起来有点无聊，
zh_hant: 我覺得可能聽起來有點無聊，

text: but the apple is the perfect snack.
You always feel good after an apple, and it makes a fantastic noise.
zh: 吃完苹果后你总感觉很好，而且它声音很棒。
zh_hant: 吃完蘋果後你總感覺很好，而且它聲音很棒。

text: When you bite into an apple, that noise is called a crunch.
zh: 当你咬苹果时，那个声音叫“咔嚓”。
zh_hant: 當你咬蘋果時，那個聲音叫“咔嚓”。

text: And it's a very nice sound.
zh: 而且那是一种很好听的声音。
zh_hant: 而且那是一種很好聽的聲音。

text: It is a nice sound.
And so we can describe apples as being crunchy.
zh: 所以我们可以用脆来形容苹果。
zh_hant: 所以我們可以用脆來形容蘋果。

text: That's the adjective.
Yeah. Okay, it's time to recap the vocabulary that we've learned.
zh: 嗯，好，现在是时候回顾我们学过的词汇了。
zh_hant: 嗯，好，現在是時候回顧我們學過的詞彙了。

text: And we'll start with sour.
And that is the taste, for example, in lemon or in vinegar.
zh: 那是例如柠檬或醋的味道。
zh_hant: 那是例如檸檬或醋的味道。

text: It's not very sweet.
Citrus fruits, for example, like grapefruit,
oranges, limes, they are very sour.
We used the word ripe.
Ripe describes fruit which is ready to eat.
We also had juicy,
and that's an adjective to describe something that has juice or liquid.
zh: 那是一个形容词，形容有汁水或液体的东西。
zh_hant: 那是一個形容詞，形容有汁水或液體的東西。

text: So, for example, a juicy fruit like a strawberry.
zh: 比如像草莓这样的多汁水果，
zh_hant: 比如像草莓這樣的多汁水果，

text: when you bite into it, juice will come out of it.
zh: 你咬下去，汁水就会流出来。
zh_hant: 你咬下去，汁水就會流出來。

text: We also heard about dried fruit.
Dried fruit has had all of the juice taken out of it,
zh: 干果是去掉了所有汁水的水果，
zh_hant: 乾果是去掉了所有汁水的水果，

text: sometimes by the sun.
So, for example, raisins are dried fruit.
zh: 比如说，葡萄干就是干果。
zh_hant: 比如說，葡萄乾就是乾果。

text: That's it for this week's episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 这期《简易英语》就到这里了。
zh_hant: 這期《簡易英語》就到這裡了。

text: You can find a free worksheet on our website to test what you've learnt from this episode.
zh: 你可以在我们的网站上找到免费练习单，测试你从这期节目中学到了什么。
zh_hant: 你可以在我們的網站上找到免費練習單，測試你從這期節目中學到了什麼。

text: That's at bbclearningenglish.com.
And we'll be back next week with another episode of Real Easy English.
zh: 下周我们会带着新一期《简易英语》回来。
zh_hant: 下週我們會帶著新一期《簡易英語》回來。

text: Join us then.
Goodbye for now.
Bye.
